full_prompt_en: A square minimalist monochrome illustration places a very small seated person near the lower-left edge of an almost entirely pale gray page. The figure sits side-on on a low curb, knees bent and hands resting forward, with short dark hair and simple gray clothing. A long, thin ground line stretches rightward beneath the figure, broken into a few rectangular pavement joints. From just above the person's head, a dense black stream of tiny marks rises diagonally to the upper right. It begins as a narrow point, expands into a large dark suspended cluster, then thins again into scattered specks at the top. The marks resemble a flock of miniature birds, ink grains, or loose thoughts; individual flecks remain visible around the edges even where the middle forms an almost solid black mass. Everything else is empty. No buildings, landscape, or decorative border explain the space, so the high white-gray negative area becomes a major part of the image. The drawing uses delicate pencil or ink hatching for the figure and curb, crisp dark micro-marks for the cloud, and a faint granular wash across the background. There is no clear directional sunlight; illumination is even and soft, with the strongest contrast entirely between the pale field and the black eruption. The visual weight rises away from the tiny grounded figure into a broad airborne shape. The whole image feels quiet and psychologically suggestive, letting a simple scale shift from body to swarm carry the emotional story.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形极简单色插画把一个很小的坐姿人物置于几乎全是浅灰纸面的左下边缘。人物侧身坐在低路缘上，膝弯曲，双手向前放着，留短黑发，穿简单灰衣。一条长细地线在脚下向右延伸，几道矩形铺路接缝把它分开。从人物头顶略上方，一股密集黑色细痕斜向右上升起。它先是一处窄尖，扩成悬空的深黑大团，再在顶端散成稀疏小点。这些痕迹像一群微型飞鸟、墨粒或松开的念头；即使中央几乎形成实黑团，边缘仍可看见单个飞散斑点。其他一切都是空的。没有建筑、风景或装饰边框解释空间，因此高处白灰留白成为图像的重要部分。绘制对人物与路缘使用细铅笔或墨线排痕，对云团用清楚的深色微痕，背景则铺淡颗粒水洗。没有明确方向的阳光；照明均匀柔和，最强对比完全来自淡场与黑色迸发。视觉重量从微小着地人物向宽阔的悬空形体升起。整幅图安静而有心理暗示，用从身体到群聚的简单尺度转变承载情绪故事。
style_prompt_en: Minimal monochrome illustration sets a tiny grounded focal mark against an overwhelming pale gray-white field. A narrow dark stream can expand diagonally into a broad suspended cluster of countless crisp flecks, then disperse into individual particles. Fine pencil-like hatching and a faint granular wash support the sparse structural linework. The center of the cluster approaches solid black, while its frayed edges remain visibly particulate. Even diffuse light avoids modeled shadow and puts all emphasis on value, scale, and directional movement. A low horizontal anchor contrasts with the ascending diagonal mass. The enormous empty areas give the compact black activity a quiet psychological charge and keep the visual metaphor open-ended.
style_prompt_zh: 极简单色插画把微小着地的焦点痕放在压倒性的浅灰白场前。一股狭窄深色流可以斜向扩成由无数清楚小点组成的宽阔悬空簇团，再散为独立颗粒。细铅笔般排痕与淡颗粒水洗辅助稀疏结构线。簇团中心接近实黑，磨散边缘仍明显由颗粒组成。均匀漫射光避开塑形阴影，把重点全放在明度、尺度与定向运动上。低位水平锚线与上升斜向体块相对。巨大空白让紧凑黑色活动带安静的心理张力，同时保留开放的隐喻。
theme_en: A seated person releasing a dark flock-like thought into empty air
theme_zh: 一名坐着的人向空中释放暗色群鸟般的思绪
name: Lim Heng Swee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
